campaign.title: Actual square-root large values with full Gram diagonal

resource_policy.budget: Three bounded analytical/source reports, conductor independent derivation, and one repair/seam-review cycle. No mathematical numerical experiments.

frozen_target.question: Can actual finite-vector large-values analysis prove the complete high-value distribution required by the twelfth-moment target?
quantities: Exact actual B_T and window in frozen strategy.
Candidate weaker envelope T^epsilon(V^-2+T V^(-136/13)) must be proved, not assumed.
Keep the complete diagonal, all localization intervals and upper tails; a generic aligned counterexample is not an arithmetic counterexample.

completion_criteria: Three bounded reports and a statement-only independent Gram/covering control.
Complete actual level-set inequality or exact first failed step with no lost diagonal, ceiling or tail.
Primary square-root source applicability and all powers independently checked.
Any new complete proved kernel receives exact-hash independent reviews and graph validation; otherwise identity patch.
Distinguish better moments from pointwise progress and keep full quarter goal.

tasks.target: Attack the frozen full actual large-value distribution using finite-vector duality and localized Gram matrices. Prove or refute the candidate D(V)<<T^epsilon(V^-2+T V^(-136/13)) by deriving the correlation interpolation from the accepted source card plus elementary derivatives, all small-u regimes, real level-set covering and full dyadic/tail recombination. Preserve all diagonal and ceiling terms. Then attempt the coefficient-sensitive improvement needed to reach the frozen target; identify exactly why any generic bound falls short. Derive the best complete moment consequence with the accepted pointwise exponent only after pricing its exact smoothing interface; do not just substitute into a printed endpoint. Seven sections and stop.
required_output: Seven-section report: result, exact hypotheses, proof, first gap, controls, dependencies, state effect.
Write only assigned report; no graph/draft/matrix/synthesis/source-card/successor edits.

tasks.target: Audit primary sources for this specific complete large-values attempt.
